culprit_line.instructions: The CI job identified by `job_id` ran `command` and exited with code `exit_code`. Which line index in `log_lines` most directly states the cause of the failure (e.g. a thrown error, a failed assertion, a stack trace location)? Read every entry in `log_lines` before choosing. If no single line states the cause, choose "0".

criteria.0: no single line in log_lines states the cause of the failure
criteria.14: npm ERR! Test failed. See above for more details.

is_infra_flake.instructions: Does `log_lines` show the failure of the job identified by `job_id` was caused by an infrastructure or environment problem (network/DNS error, container or runner crash, out-of-memory kill, disk full, connection reset, timeout reaching an external service) rather than a defect in the code or tests run by `command`?

criteria.true: log_lines shows an infrastructure/environment failure unrelated to the code under test
criteria.false: log_lines shows the code or tests themselves failing, or gives no evidence of an infra problem
